land_pattern.package: RGE0024B, VQFN 24-pin, 1mm max height, 4.0mm x 4.0mm body
land_pattern.notes: Perimeter pads 24x(0.25 x 0.6mm) at 0.5mm pitch on a 3.8mm x 3.8mm span (IPC land pattern, non-solder-mask-defined preferred). Exposed thermal pad is pad 25, nominal 2.45mm square (package outline), with an optional 20x via array (0.5mm pitch) under the pad per TI's example board layout; TI recommends vias under paste be filled, plugged, or tented. pad_count counts the exposed pad (pad 25), as the footprint does.
